[USER] User is looking for a recipe for a savory tart with cheese and herbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended recipes for savory tarts:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Caramelized Onion, Goat Cheese, and Thyme Tart  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Spinach, Feta, and Sun-dried Tomato Tart  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Roasted Garlic and Rosemary Tart  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Caramelized Shallot, Blue Cheese, and Fresh Parsley Tart  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Asparagus, Goat Cheese, and Chive Tart  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a basic recipe template for a savory tart crust:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 cups all-purpose flour  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/4 cup ice-cold water  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Salt, to taste  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided filling suggestions:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1-2 cups grated cheese (e.g., goat cheese, feta, Parmesan, Cheddar)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup chopped fresh herbs (e.g., thyme, rosemary, parsley, chives)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup caramelized onions or shallots (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup roasted garlic (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup sautéed mushrooms or asparagus (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Salt and pepper, to taste  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided instructions for making the savory tart:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Make the tart crust and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Roll out the dough and place it in a tart pan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Prepare the filling and spread it over the crust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Bake for 35-40 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Let cool slightly before serving.
